// @action: refactor Convert to optional chain expression/Convert to optional chain expression
// @file: src/main.ts
interface User { profile?: { name: string; tags: string[]; greet(): string } }
export function name(u: User | undefined) {
  if (u && /*|*/u.profile && u.profile.greet()) {
    return u && u.profile && u.profile.tags[0];
  }
  return '';
}
